title: C parser module + complexity branches
description: Session 1 of the C adapter arc. Add tree-sitter-c dependency, create the C parser module, and add complexity branches. This is the densest step — the parser module alone is ~400-600 lines.

acceptance_criteria.text: src/parser/c.rs created with parse() function returning ParseResult

Symbol extraction covers: function_definition→Function, struct_specifier(with body)→Struct, enum_specifier(with body)→Enum, type_definition→TypeAlias, preproc_function_def→Macro, preproc_def→Const (header guard filtered), top-level declaration→Static/Const
Header guard filter excludes names ending in _H, _H_, _INCLUDED, _INCLUDED_
Visibility: static storage class → private, else → pub
Signatures: return_type function_name(params) extracted from declarator nodes
References classified: call_expression→Call, field_expression→FieldAccess, type_identifier in param/return→TypeUse, struct initializer→Construction
#include directives produce ExtractedImport with raw_path preserving quotes/angles
language_attrs JSON: returns_ptr, takes_ptr, is_static, is_inline, is_variadic, has_const, returns_void, has_struct_param
Flags: test file heuristics (*_test.c, test_*.c, tests/*.c), test_* function names, __attribute__→FFI entry
classify_cognitive has 'c' branch: if/for/while/do→(true,true), switch→(true,false), case/goto→(true,false)
walk_cyclomatic has 'c' branch: if/for/while/do/goto +1, case +1, switch -1, logical operators +1
pub mod c added to src/parser/mod.rs

implementation_plan:
## Approach

Create the C parser module and complexity branches. Follow the `rust::parse` pattern exactly.

## Files

- **Modify**: `Cargo.toml` — add `tree-sitter-c` dependency
- **Create**: `src/parser/c.rs` — full C parser module
- **Modify**: `src/parser/mod.rs` — add `pub mod c;`
- **Modify**: `src/parser/complexity.rs` — add `"c"` branches to `classify_cognitive` (before `_ =>` fallback at line 145) and `walk_cyclomatic` (before `_ => {}` at line 51)

## Steps

### Step 1: Add tree-sitter-c dependency

```toml
tree-sitter-c = "0.23"
```

### Step 2: Create `src/parser/c.rs`

Core structure:

```rust
pub fn parse(ctx: &ParseContext) -> Result<ParseResult>

// Symbol extraction
fn collect_symbols(node: Node, src: &[u8], file_path: &str) -> Vec<ExtractedSymbol>
fn collect_symbols_inner(node: Node, src: &[u8], file_path: &str, symbols: &mut Vec<ExtractedSymbol>)
fn extract_function(node: Node, src: &[u8], file_path: &str) -> Option<ExtractedSymbol>
fn extract_struct(node: Node, src: &[u8]) -> Option<ExtractedSymbol>
fn extract_enum(node: Node, src: &[u8]) -> Option<ExtractedSymbol>
fn extract_typedef(node: Node, src: &[u8]) -> Option<ExtractedSymbol>
fn extract_macro(node: Node, src: &[u8]) -> Option<ExtractedSymbol>  // preproc_function_def
fn extract_const_define(node: Node, src: &[u8]) -> Option<ExtractedSymbol>  // preproc_def, with guard filter
fn extract_global_var(node: Node, src: &[u8]) -> Option<ExtractedSymbol>  // top-level declaration
fn is_header_guard(name: &str) -> bool

// Helpers
fn extract_visibility(node: Node, src: &[u8]) -> Option<String>  // static → "private", else "pub"
fn extract_docstring(node: Node, src: &[u8]) -> Option<String>
fn build_fn_signature(node: Node, src: &[u8]) -> Option<String>
fn extract_flags(file_path: &str, name: &str, node: Node, src: &[u8]) -> u32
fn extract_language_attrs(node: Node, src: &[u8]) -> Option<String>  // JSON with returns_ptr etc.

// References
fn collect_references(node: Node, src: &[u8]) -> Vec<ExtractedRef>
fn walk_refs_recursive(node: Node, src: &[u8], refs: &mut Vec<ExtractedRef>)
fn is_definition_name(node: Node) -> bool
fn classify_ref_context(node: Node) -> RefContextKind

// Imports
fn collect_includes(node: Node, src: &[u8]) -> Vec<ExtractedImport>
```

### Step 3: Add complexity branches

`classify_cognitive` — add `"c"` arm:
```rust
"c" => match kind {
    "if_statement" => (true, true),
    "while_statement" | "for_statement" | "do_statement" => (true, true),
    "switch_statement" => (true, false),
    "case_statement" | "goto_statement" => (true, false),
    _ => (false, false),
},
```

`walk_cyclomatic` — add `"c"` arm:
```rust
"c" => match kind {
    "if_statement" | "while_statement" | "for_statement" | "do_statement" => { *count += 1; }
    "case_statement" => { *count += 1; }
    "switch_statement" => { *count = count.saturating_sub(1); }
    "binary_expression" if is_logical_operator(node, src) => { *count += 1; }
    "goto_statement" => { *count += 1; }
    _ => {}
},
```

### Step 4: Wire module declaration

Add `pub mod c;` to `src/parser/mod.rs`.
execution_record: Followed the implementation plan step by step. Three fixes needed during testing: (1) struct/enum in tree-sitter-c appear as direct children of translation_unit, not wrapped in `declaration` — added top-level arms; (2) `typedef unsigned long size_t` produces a `primitive_type` node for `size_t` — added to `find_name_in_declarator`; (3) `is_test_file` missed paths starting with `tests/` (no leading slash). All discovered via failing tests in the first pass. 41 tests total, full suite green.

messages.text:
Review: approve with notes.

3 medium findings (definition-name leak through pointer/array declarator wrappers, struct/enum docstring extracted from wrong anchor node, comma-separated declarators silently dropped), 2 low (signature misses type qualifiers, ternary not counted in complexity). Core extraction is correct for common C constructs; issues are interaction patterns with tree-sitter AST wrapping. Codex concurred on definition-name leak, docstring anchor, and multi-declarator findings independently.

Recommend fixing the 3 mediums before closing the arc — they cause incomplete symbol tables and noisy reference graphs."
